message:
Let me find the Fuzz_pac harness and the krb5_parse_pac function.

<｜｜DSML｜｜=execute_bash>
<parameter=command>find /workspace/repo-vul/src-vul/krb5 -name "Fuzz_pac*" -o -name "*pac*" | head -20 && echo "---" && grep -rn "krb5_parse_pac" /workspace/repo-vul/src-vul/krb5/src --include="*.c" -l 2>/dev/null</parameter>
</｜｜DSML｜｜>
